text:
Now write SQL: percentage of carcinogenic molecules among molecules that contain triple bonds ('#').

Percentage = count of molecules with triple bond AND label='+' / count of molecules with triple bond * 100.

Let me run it.

input.sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN m.molecule_id END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS pct_carcinogenic FROM molecule m WHERE m.molecule_id IN (SELECT bond_id_check.molecule_id FROM (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '#') AS bond_id_check)

Let me simplify the SQL for evidence and check the numbers.

input.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) AS total_triple_molecules, SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carcinogenic FROM (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '#') b JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
